title: Flood Fill: The Paint Bucket Spreading Ring by Ring
summary: Paint the clicked pixel, then spread to same-colored neighbors one ring at a time with a queue.

takeaway.summary: Start from one cell, queue it, and repeatedly take the front cell and queue its matching neighbors. Marking a cell when it's queued means it's never handled twice.
whenToUse: Filling or measuring a connected region of a grid
Anything that spreads to neighbors step by step

scenes.narration: A tiny picture stores a color number in each pixel. You click the paint bucket on the top-left pixel with color 5. Every color-2 pixel connected to it, up, down, left, or right, must change.
scenes.caption: Paint bucket on pixel (0,0): recolor its color-2 region to 5

scenes.narration: You could sweep the whole picture again and again, painting anything next to paint, until a sweep changes nothing. Most sweeps would recheck the same pixels.
scenes.caption: Rescanning the whole picture until nothing changes is slow

scenes.narration: Instead, paint the clicked pixel and put it in a queue. The queue holds pixels whose neighbors still need checking.
scenes.caption: Paint the clicked pixel and put it in the queue

scenes.narration: Take (0,0) off the front and look in four directions. Below and to the right are color 2, so paint them and queue them: that's the first ring.
scenes.caption: Its color-2 neighbors are painted and join the queue

scenes.narration: Pixel (0,1) touches color 0 below and to the right, and paint on its left. Nothing new joins the queue.
scenes.caption: Pixel (0,1) only touches other colors: nothing to add

scenes.narration: The paint spreads down the left column and along the bottom, one ring at a time. When the queue is empty, every connected color-2 pixel is 5.
scenes.caption: The queue empties: the whole color-2 region is now 5

scenes.narration: That's breadth-first search on a grid: a queue of cells to expand, marked when they join so none is handled twice. Each pixel is visited at most once: O(rows times columns).
scenes.caption: One queue, one visit per pixel: breadth-first search
